title: 101-year-old recalls a giant graveyard found while ploughing for a vineyard
summary: Tim Alberino tells of 101-year-old recalls a giant graveyard found while ploughing for a vineyard, about 1920s-1930s at near a nuraghe, Sardinia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Sardinian giant graveyard cleared by men in vans and tower passage sealed

plain: A man who investigates stories of ancient giants, Tim Alberino, says a 101-year-old named Anna Tuary told him that in the 1920s or 1930s, while ground was being ploughed for a vineyard near a nuraghe, an ancient stone tower on the Italian island of Sardinia, workers suddenly began unearthing the remains of gigantic people. In a second telling, Alberino adds that vans pulled up, men got out with equipment and took the remains away while a witness hid, and that a passage in the tower was sealed. If true, it would mean a race of giants once lived there and the evidence was quietly removed.
